design_notes: The Air Travel text (lines 558-559) says to choose the lowest fare available, with no exception. Appendix C (lines 1399-1402) says the 2020 revision of Airplane and Train 'added option for flexibility for those whose schedules frequently change', and this inspector's schedule does. Whether the directive lets them buy a changeable fare ($339) above the lowest ($227) is open: hold either. No role is named; the manager seeks direction on questions of application (line 1064); a hold may also name the deputy minister, who may set additional rules on expenses (lines 167-172), or TB/MBC, the only body that grants an exemption (lines 207-209).
